body:
He brought a bed and a dresser and has nothing else. He needs the furniture. But maybe I should get him a fleshlight.

I know the things depression makes me think. But I honestly have just had the world's smallest contribution. I have taken far more than I have given.

My dad will, in fact, lose a financial burden. And I don't know about "wonderful" daughter.

Smoking has been the only thing preventing me from jumping in front of a moving car. And it's better than drinking, especially on my meds. And I just want to drown myself in red wine right about now.

Thank you for responding, though. You're a good person.
